name: @knolo/core
description: Deterministic, verifiable Knowledge Images, local-first retrieval, and KAR evidence-set retrieval over a Committed Evidence Graph.
author: Sam Paniagua

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-kar-schemas.mjs && node scripts/copy-composition-schemas.mjs && node scripts/copy-cortex-schemas.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && node scripts/check-runtime-no-node.mjs && npm run build --prefix ../../research/kar-1 && node --test test/*.test.mjs && node scripts/test.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write src/agent.ts src/pack.ts src/pack.runtime.ts src/pack.node.ts src/node.ts src/builder.ts src/live.ts src/index.ts src/knowledge_studio_v5.ts src/knowledge_studio_v5.node.ts src/knowledge_sync_host_v5.ts src/knowledge_sync_host_v5.node.ts src/knowledge_lease_v5.node.ts src/knowledge_authorized_operations_v5.ts scripts/test.mjs scripts/check-runtime-no-node.mjs ../../README.md README.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src/agent.ts src/pack.ts src/pack.runtime.ts src/pack.node.ts src/node.ts src/builder.ts src/live.ts src/index.ts src/knowledge_studio_v5.ts src/knowledge_studio_v5.node.ts src/knowledge_sync_host_v5.ts src/knowledge_sync_host_v5.node.ts src/knowledge_lease_v5.node.ts src/knowledge_authorized_operations_v5.ts scripts/test.mjs scripts/check-runtime-no-node.mjs ../../README.md README.md
